summary: One source-equivalent synthetic controller/runtime/emitted-tree run confirmed that a loaded no-match directory query can be edited and explicitly resubmitted to recover a seeded profile while retaining the selected geography. The controlled local read failure was visibly distinct and explicit retry recovered. No recovery defect was observed. The navigation tree exposes a glyph-only toggle without an explicit aria-label; browser-computed accessible name and keyboard behavior were not tested, so this remains a qualified source-level affordance observation rather than a verified accessibility defect.

execution.signal_qualification: The shell wrapper records child exit status but does not independently instrument an OS signal; exit 0 is the observed result.
execution.capture_qualification: Wrapper-created start/end and stdout/stderr/exit captures are retained. Do not claim all capture file descriptors were pre-opened before process launch.
